<subject>WINDGRID/GRID STATUS UPDATE</subject>
<body>
To all WINDGRID operators:

The WINDGRID platform will be offline nightly from 00:01 to 04:00 CET for scheduled data consolidation. The system will be back online early morning, with grid status refreshed by 05:30.

Grid control functions remain accessible during this window.

Please contact the WINDGRID Support Line (+49 171 373 5700) for any questions or issues.
</body>
